jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Since 1892, OPW customers have been able to count on us to revolutionize fluid-handling operations around the world. As a global leader in fluid-handling solutions, the mission of OPW is to be a developer of a comprehensive array of innovative fluid-handling solutions that our customers can consistently and reliably count on. These include loading and unloading systems for high-value hazardous and non-hazardous bulk products; railcar and transport tank-truck valves, gauging devices and tank-monitoring systems; automated storage-terminal controls and systems; and regulators, fittings, valves, vaporizers, vacuum-jacketed piping and gas-handling systems for the safe handling and distribution of cryogenics and industrial gases. OPW has more than 2,000 employees with manufacturing operations in North America, Europe and China, and sales offices around the world. OPW is part of the Clean Energy & Fueling segment of Dover (NYSE: DOV).

This position can be located in Elon, NC or Allentown, PA or Ball Ground, GA.

The Product Manager is responsible for bringing OPW CES product vision to life for new product development by translating customer needs into prioritized innovation roadmaps and bringing the products to market. This role is intended to be an onsite role located at our Elon, NC site reporting to the Director of Product Management.  In order to ensure success, the Product Manager must possess the following attributes: strategic thinker, bias for action, process-oriented, analytical, willing to go the extra distance to meet customer expectations, communicating succinctly with customers/senior leaders, and be able to contribute to a dynamic fast paced environment.

What You’ll Do
- Manage P&L including strategic planning, annual strategy deployment and budget
- Actively manage financial performance of product lines across all market segments, including bookings and gross profitability results.   Understand and manage the impacts of product line and geographic mix.
- Establish leadership in cross-functional New Product Development (NPD) core teams and ensure adherence to market and product requirements from pre-concept tollgate and through product development cycle.
- Gather and represent the voice of customer and voice of business on NPD core teams and lead market discussions at monthly Product Planning Group (PPG) meetings to assess and manage risk and tradeoffs.
- Lead the development as a customer champion to identify customer pain points, user needs and ensure our products solve valuable problems in attractive segments.
- Perform market and customer insight research to deeply understand customer problems and needs and challenges and translate these together with a cross-functional team into diagnostic solutions.
- Represent the company by visiting customers to solicit feedback on company products and services.
- Analyze competitive landscape including product offerings, performance claims, overall market positioning and selling strategies to develop and maintain action plans, drive product portfolio growth and gain market share.
- Improve product marketability and profitability by defining detailed value proposition through research, identification and capitalization on competitive differentiators
- Identify new business opportunities for new and existing products and develop selling tools to help commercial representatives in targeting the right customers and applications as well as responding to customer needs and overcoming objections and competitive threats.
- Develop and present business cases for NPD by developing the file and driving process, defining market requirements and writing product definitions.
- Contribute to rationalized roadmap creation and maintenance, Incremental Pipeline Value (IPV) and metrics aligned with Strategic Plan
- Execute Product Life Cycle Management and SKU rationalization and obsolescence processes
- Actively manage all commercial aspects of the OPW CES portfolio including brand, pricing, promotion and service levels.
- Develop, execute and maintain pricing strategies that maximize profitability, support market competitiveness and align with Product Life Cycle goals
- Support development and execution of Marketing plans, including product launches, tools, and customer and industry communication.
- Maintain effective communication and interaction with the customers and internally with Commercial, R&D, Operations and other key functional groups within the company.

What You’ll Bring
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Engineering or Business required.
- MBA or graduate degree in related field a plus.
- Five years progressively responsible product management experience.
- Operating in a continuous improvement environment and process orientation.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work with people from various functional disciplines including sales, marketing, R&D, engineering, manufacturing, legal, and finance.
- Must have the ability to actively manage multiple projects and priorities concurrently.
- Ability to translate market, customer and application requirements into clear and concrete product design characteristics as well as marketing, sales and pricing strategies.
- Good knowledge of Cryogenic and industrial gas markets
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite; Salesforce.com and Adobe product knowledge.
- Proven ability to manage databases, as well as Product or Project Management software proficiency (Smartsheet a plus).
- Proficient in MRP/ERP; Infor XA a plus.
- Up to 30% travel, mainly domestic possible international occasionally

#LI-GP1

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payment Solutions
jobs.description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Overall Scope:

The Senior Product Manager – Payment Solutions will lead the strategy, development, commercialization, and lifecycle management of enterprise payment, loyalty, outdoor payment, and forecourt solutions across North America. This role will translate customer, market, regulatory, and business needs into a clear product vision, prioritized roadmap, and executable delivery plan.

The Senior Product Manager will lead the strategy, discovery, and lifecycle management of outdoor payment terminal solutions across key verticals, including fuel dispensers, electric vehicle charging stations, car washes, and other unattended or self-service environments. In addition, the role will define, discover, and develop integrated forecourt solutions for strategic DFS customers, ensuring that their operational, commercial, and customer-experience needs are translated into scalable products, capabilities, and services.

The role will own end-to-end requirements gathering, product discovery, business-case development, roadmap creation, prioritization, and cross-functional execution. The position will work closely with strategic customers, commercial teams, engineering, architecture, compliance, operations, partners, and senior leadership to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and commercially successful solutions.

This position will balance customer experience, technical feasibility, regulatory compliance, operational readiness, revenue growth, profitability, and market opportunity while ensuring that customer-specific innovations support the broader DFS product portfolio and long-term product strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Vision
·       Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, objectives, and success measures for assigned payment and loyalty products.
·       Align product strategy with company objectives, regional market opportunities, customer needs, and portfolio priorities.
·       Lead product lifecycle management from discovery and business-case development through launch, optimization, and retirement.
·       Identify opportunities for product convergence, platform reuse, standardization, and scalable regional capabilities.
·       Establish measurable objectives and key results, including adoption, revenue, margin, customer satisfaction, operational performance, and delivery outcomes.

Requirements Gathering and Product Discovery
·       Lead structured requirements-gathering activities with enterprise customers, internal product teams, commercial stakeholders, suppliers, channel partners, and end users.
·       Develop and maintain customer personas, journey maps, use cases, process flows, and product requirement documentation.
·       Translate business and customer needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements.
·       Facilitate discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, design sessions, proof-of-concept reviews, and solution-validation activities.
·       Balance competing requirements across customer segments, regions, payment channels, and product lines.
·       Ensure requirements address usability, accessibility, performance, scalability, reliability, security, privacy, compliance, and operational supportability.
·       Establish traceability between customer needs, business objectives, product requirements, delivery outcomes, and measurable benefits.
·       Validate requirements with stakeholders and obtain appropriate business, technical, compliance, and operational approvals.

Roadmap Development and Prioritization
·       Build, own, and continuously refine the North America payment solutions roadmap.
·       Maintain short-, medium-, and long-term roadmap views covering capabilities, features, integrations, compliance mandates, technical enablers, and platform improvements.
·       Prioritize roadmap investments using customer value, strategic alignment, revenue potential, risk reduction, regulatory urgency, delivery effort, technical dependencies, and total cost of ownership.
·       Present roadmap recommendations and trade-offs to senior leadership and governance forums.
·       Coordinate roadmap dependencies across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, compliance, operations, sales, marketing, and other product leaders.
·       Incorporate market requirements, customer commitments, payment-network changes, scheme mandates, certification timelines, and product lifecycle considerations into roadmap planning.
·       Monitor roadmap execution and adjust priorities based on changing market conditions, delivery performance, customer feedback, and business results.

Delivery Leadership and Agile Execution
·       Drive engineering priorities through Agile planning and Program Increment planning processes.
·       Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to define release objectives, scope, sequencing, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
·       Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, system demonstrations, retrospectives, release planning, and dependency management.
·       Ensure product backlogs remain prioritized, actionable, and aligned with roadmap objectives.
·       Lead cross-functional resolution of scope, priority, dependency, quality, and delivery risks.
·       Coordinate product readiness across development, testing, certification, deployment, operations, training, and support.
·       Track delivery progress, risks, issues, decisions, and outcomes, escalating matters appropriately.
·       Ensure delivered capabilities meet agreed requirements and provide measurable customer and business value.

Customer and Stakeholder Leadership
·       Establish a consistent Voice of Customer program using interviews, advisory sessions, feedback analysis, usage data, and customer satisfaction insights.
·       Build trusted relationships with strategic customers, commercial teams, channel partners, payment providers, and internal stakeholders.
·       Represent customer and market needs in product, architecture, engineering, and executive discussions.
·       Facilitate executive-level communications on product strategy, roadmap progress, risks, investment decisions, and outcomes.
·       Influence without direct authority across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
·       Communicate complex technical, commercial, and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Business Cases, Commercialization, and Financial Management
·       Identify and develop business cases for new products, features, integrations, and platform capabilities.
·       Quantify customer value, revenue opportunity, investment requirements, operating costs, risks, payback, and expected return on investment.
·       Partner with finance and commercial teams to develop product forecasts, investment proposals, pricing models, and profitability analyses.
·       Support packaging and pricing decisions using customer data, sales history, market intelligence, competitive analysis, and cost information.
·       Monitor product performance against revenue, margin, adoption, retention, cost, and customer-value targets.
·       Recommend corrective actions when products do not meet financial or market objectives.

Market and Competitive Analysis
·       Conduct market research to identify customer trends, competitor offerings, emerging technologies, and unmet needs.
·       Perform ongoing competitive analysis across payment hardware, software, loyalty, POS, gateway, acquiring, and integrated commerce solutions.
·       Assess market-entry opportunities, product gaps, differentiation strategies, and potential threats.
·       Use research and data-driven insights to influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, positioning, and investment priorities.
·       Monitor relevant developments in payment technology, digital commerce, unattended payments, fuel retail, loyalty, fraud prevention, and customer experience.

Compliance, Standards, and Risk Management
·       Maintain awareness of regional payment regulations, network requirements, scheme mandates, and industry standards.
·       Partner with compliance, legal, security, architecture, and engineering teams to incorporate PCI, EMV, privacy, security, and other applicable requirements.
·       Plan roadmap activities to account for certification, testing, approval, migration, and implementation timelines.
·       Identify product risks and ensure mitigation plans are reflected in product and delivery planning.
·       Support engagement with relevant industry organizations and standards bodies, including the U.S. Payments Forum, NACS, and Conexxus, where appropriate.
·       Ensure product documentation and launch plans accurately reflect regulatory, technical, and operational requirements.
Go-to-Market and Product Enablement
·       Partner with sales, marketing, customer success, implementation, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies.
·       Define product positioning, value propositions, target segments, use cases, launch plans, and competitive messaging.
·       Provide sales enablement materials, product presentations, demonstrations, training, FAQs, and objection-handling guidance.
·       Support customer proposals, solution workshops, executive briefings, pilots, and strategic account engagements.
·       Coordinate internal readiness for product launches, including support processes, documentation, training, pricing, contracting, and operational procedures.
·       Measure launch effectiveness and use market feedback to improve future releases.

Product Operations and Continuous Improvement
·       Establish product governance, decision rights, operating processes, and documentation standards.
·       Monitor product health using adoption, performance, quality, incident, support, customer, and commercial metrics.
·       Identify opportunities to improve product usability, reliability, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
·       Lead post-launch reviews and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future planning.
·       Maintain current product documentation, roadmaps, requirements, release plans, and stakeholder communications.
·       Mentor product managers and contribute to product-management capability development.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

·       Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
·       8+ years of product management, product strategy, engineering, systems analysis, or related experience , preferably involving payment hardware and software solutions.
·       3+ years of regional, platform, or portfolio-level product ownership .
·       Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, gathering requirements, defining product vision, and building and executing roadmaps.
·       Proven experience leading complex, interdependent products or programs across multiple functions and geographic regions.
·       Experience delivering products deployed within the payments ecosystem.
·       Strong understanding of payment-platform architecture, transaction flows, POS functionality, payment hardware, software integrations, and related services.
·       Working knowledge of PCI, EMV, payment-network certifications, tokenization, encryption, fraud controls, and applicable compliance requirements.
·       Experience with Agile product development, backlog management, release planning, and Program Increment planning.
·       Demonstrated experience developing business cases, evaluating investment opportunities, and supporting pricing or commercialization decisions.
·       Experience working with customers, suppliers, channel partners, commercial teams, engineering, architecture, compliance, cybersecurity, and operations.
·       Experience in the fuel, convenience retail, hospitality, or unattended-payment industries is desirable.
·       Industry involvement with organizations such as the U.S. Payments Forum, NACS, or Conexxus is desirable.
·       Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones.
·       Strong customer-centered product-management mindset.
·       Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Success Measures:

·       Delivery of an approved, prioritized, and actionable product roadmap.
·       Quality, completeness, and traceability of product requirements.
·       Customer adoption, satisfaction, retention, and measurable Voice of Customer improvements.
·       Delivery of committed product outcomes within agreed scope, timing, quality, and investment parameters.
·       Revenue growth, margin improvement, product profitability, and return on investment.
·       Timely completion of regulatory, payment-network, and certification requirements.
·       Successful product launches and commercial readiness.
·       Reduction of product, operational, compliance, and delivery risks.
·       Effective management of cross-functional dependencies.
·       Improved reuse, convergence, scalability, and operational efficiency across the product portfolio.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager - Industrial Manufacturing
jobs.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

Starting range: $95,000.00 - $110,000.00 annually

Summary:

The Associate Product Manager will report to the Director of Product Management, assisting in the strategic direction and daily execution of the product line lifecycle. price and position analysis, and recommendations to maximize market share, profit and revenue across the PSG California portfolio including All-Flo, Griswold, Neptune and Wilden.  The Associate Product Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure PSG California meets both customer and market expectations.

Qualifications/Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or related field
- 3+ years of relevant experience in product management, sales, or marketing
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Ability to multi-task and perform in a fast pace, dynamic environment.
- Self-sufficient, self-motivated, works with moderate supervision.
- Strong team player, great work ethic, passionate and a commitment to win.
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
- Demonstrated analytical skills to interpret data and make informed decisions.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Support the development and execution of product line strategies for the PSG California portfolio that supports the market and customer penetration objectives of the global sales team. This includes: -  Product pricing and margin maintenance
-  New product development
-  Life cycle planning for enhancement and obsolescence
-  Product forecasts, inventory guidance and cost targets

- Conduct market, industry, and competitive analysis to develop specific value propositions for the assigned portfolio and ensure competitive market alignment.
- Define new product development opportunities and build a robust funnel of prospective new investment projects in both existing and new markets.
- Build business cases for new product opportunities through Voice of Customer (VOC) research and establish product specifications and design targets for these new products.
- Effectively manage and communicate product launches, product changes, and product promotions both internally and externally working closely with the marketing communications team.
- Coordinate the promotion of products and services to deliver profitable growth.
- Provide support to the sales force through management of technical support resources, identification of target markets/accounts, and support on virtual and in-person meetings and customer calls.
- Perform other related duties and assignments as required.

Travel:

Regular travel required

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee for successful performance of the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
While performing the duties of this position, the employee is required to use hands regularly to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, controls, and equipment. The employee is required to both see and hear.  The employee must be able to walk, sit and stand. The employee occasionally lifts to 25 lbs. and occasionally kneels and bends.

Work Environment:

The environment is both office and manufacturing. The manufacturing environment is subject to moderate changes in temperature, and the employee will be exposed to typical hazards of noise, flying debris, and overhead hazards requiring the use of proper PPE (Personal Protective Equipment).

This position may also require overtime as necessary. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.

Work Arrangement: Onsite

Benefits: Benefits for this position include:  a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; medical, dental and vision insurance; wellness programs; health savings account, health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts; company paid short-term disability and long-term disability; company paid employee basic life and AD&D insurance; supplemental employee and dependent life insurance; optional accident, hospital indemnity and critical illness insurance; adoption, surrogacy, and fertility benefits and assistance; commuter benefits; parental, military, jury duty, and bereavement leaves of absence; paid time off, including 11 paid holidays per calendar year, paid vacation days beginning at 120 hours annually, 40 paid sick leave hours annually or as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, tuition assistance; business travel services; employee discounts; and an employee assistance program that includes company paid counseling sessions and legal services. Eligibility for benefits is governed by applicable plan documents and policies.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Dover Food Retail (DFR) is a leading manufacturer of Display Cases, Specialty Products, Refrigeration Systems, Power Systems and Comprehensive Services; and leading our industry by Innovating What’s Next in glass doors and intelligent merchandising technologies that keep food safe under brands such as HillPhoenix and Anthony.

DFR is part of the Refrigeration and Food Equipment segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer with annual revenues in excess of $7 billion.

DFR is built on creativity and customer-centric innovation delivered by people invigorated by a strong sense of responsibility to help our customers win in their marketplaces. The relationships we build with our customers are as important to our success as the products we manufacture. This collaborative environment delivers FRESH THINKING, reassuring our customers that they choose the best when they choose to work with the people of Dover Food Retail.

Job Title:  Product Manager

Location:     Richmond, VA

What we are looking for:

We are looking for a Product Manager who will be tasked with managing their product portfolios throughout the product lifecycle from planning to execution in support of organizational strategy and objectives.

This position is responsible for customer VOC, category management, product line simplifications, margin enhancement and the planning / execution of new product development. This position includes product lifecycle management, support of the global sales effort, and development of new products and strategies for the assigned product lines across product lines. This Product Manager must work with a cross functional team of stakeholders at multiple locations to understand problems and find innovative solutions.

Essential Competencies:

- Develop and execute annual and long-term (3-5years) growth strategies. Deliverables include product, technology and/or service roadmap and associated business case.

- Work with cross functional team to implement AOP initiatives to enhance profitability of products

- Develop comprehensive product definitions including models, base configurations and required options enabling guided selling and portfolio simplification

- Develop a library of market segments and applications and identify what products are required to be successful in these areas. Determine market size (revenue, units), growth and opportunity for each collaborating with corporate market research. Identify market drivers and customer buying behaviors.

- Perform competitive analysis including SWOT, pricing, features and product breadth comparisons to establish price/value positioning.

- Provide pricing guidance and work with pricing team to develop pricing for new products or offerings. Collaborate with enterprise pricing group on strategic pricing initiatives.

- Clearly identify target customers and market, primary benefit, and value proposition of the product.

- Product simplification, core definition & product lifecycle management of assigned product lines.

- Maintain market focus by regular contact with customers, sales and marketing. This includes responsibility for conducting distributor and end user training. Work closely with sales management to provide forums to interact with customers in identifying growth opportunities and new product development ideas.

- Perform regular VOC to identify market trends, market drivers, customer satisfaction level needs and buying behavior.

- Work closely with Marketing in areas of advertising, promotion marketing campaigns and driving go to market product launch efforts.

- Provide Sales, Customers and Channel Partners with support, information and materials to learn about products and applications.

- Provide project management support for major cross-functional projects as well as product management projects.

- Attend regional and national sales meetings and conferences

- Ability to present products via internet conferencing, in-person meetings, tradeshows or other industry events

- Assist with other strategic projects and related duties as assigned

Minimum Quantifiable Competencies:

- Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field such as economics, communication, advertising, marketing, or statistics

- 3-5 years of experience in Product Management, Market Analysis, Category Management, Sales Management, or similar role

Preferred Competencies:

- Master’s degree or MBA preferred

- Experience in food retail or refrigeration industry preferred

Strengths needed for this role:

- Experience in understanding customer needs. Possess a commercial mindset and comprehension of marketing and sales principles

- Understanding of data analysis and forecasting methods

- Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization

- Ability to multi-task competing priorities and projects at the same time

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Strong computer skills—including Microsoft suite of products including Power BI

How We Define Our Values and Why You Should Join Our Team:

The backbone behind our collection of outstanding businesses is a team of dedicated employees who protect and enhance our valued reputation for quality and delivering what we promise. It’s our values that define Dover to all of our key audiences: our shareholders, customers, prospective employees and especially to ourselves.

These values must be expressed in our work and embody our actions, as they form the basis by which we do our jobs, make decisions and measure our performance. It’s our unwavering commitment to maintaining our values that defines who we are as a Company.

- Collaborative Entrepreneurial Spirit

- Respects and Values People

- Expectations for Results

- Medical, Dental, and Vision

- 401k Retirement Plan

- Flexible Spending

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management
jobs.description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Overall Scope:

The Senior Manager of Product Management for the fueling industry’s most innovative customer experience platform plays a critical role on the NA Product Management team at Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS). Responsible for DFS’s Anthem UX platform (primarily software and integrated enabling hardware), the Product Senior Manager will define the product roadmap and execute strategies and tactics to drive products and enhancements from ideation to greatness while increasing market share and profitability. Core responsibilities include ensuring that the product fulfills NA customer requirements and business objectives while achieving DFS business goals, blending market insight with business strategy to steer product development and collaborating closely with engineering/R&D, manufacturing, sales, DFS partners and marketing teams.

Responsibilities:

•    Identify market opportunities, understand customer needs, and define the overall strategy and goals for the Anthem UX platform and all related fuel dispenser and EV charger applications and integrations.
•    Create the product roadmap for the product portfolio with a clear plan on how new NA market opportunities aligned with new product features will deliver the annual revenue and profit plans.
•    Manage the revenue and margin for the product portfolio including pricing.
•    Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to understand the market needs and the product’s position within the market.
•    Establish relationships with key accounts and market segments while actively seeking Voice-Of-Market (VOM) and product feedback.
•    Accountable for product portfolio lifecycle from definition through End-of-Life activities. Throughout the product lifecycle, monitor product performance against key metrics and goals. Based on this data, make informed decisions to optimize the product portfolio.
•    Develop a close collaboration with the commercial sales team including forecasting, win/loss, and competitive analysis.
•    Demonstrate excellence in execution; aligning key stakeholders to decisions, engineering and operations, highly collaborative with cross-functional partners and customers.
•    Support and work closely with the product manufacturing and SaaS organizations to actively maintain product quality and operational margin.
•    Communicate with stakeholders, including company executives, to report on product performance, progress, and future plans.
•    Lead competitive benchmarking efforts to ensure market positioning is consistent with strategic objectives for the product for the product line.
•    Collaborate with select customers to capture the return on investment (ROI) for how the adoption of the Anthem UX platform has positively impacted their business.
•    Monitor the overall volume, revenue, profitability, hit rate and warranty costs of the product lines.
•    Periodically visits (with sales) customer sites to establish and maintain relationships with key customer contacts thus maintaining a deep technical intimacy with all aspects of the product and its application.
•    Assist in any necessary training as needed: customers, engineering, support, sales, field service etc.
•    Provide tactical sales support as necessary, including presentations and demonstrations to key customers.
•    Collaborate with Marketing on defining and creating all needed product literature and documentation including web site content and social media campaigns.

Experience:

•    6+ years of relevant product management experience (ideally in software/hardware customer interfacing SaaS platform solutions).
•    BS/BA required or equivalent experience.
•    Knowledge in the retail or commercial fueling industry (gas stations, convenience stores, point of sale, loyalty programs, etc.) preferred but not required.
•    Prior experience in UI/UX product development.
•    Demonstrated success in growing market share, developing new products, and creating brand loyalty.
•    Demonstrated history working with a dynamic sales team with multiple sales channels.
•    Experience in leading new high-tech solutions and communicating features, advantages, and benefits.
•    Prior experience working in a fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams.
•    Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Essential Functions:

•    Ability to quickly learn and understand DFS products, solutions, customers, and overall market.
•    Highly motivated self-starter with excellent organizational skills. Continuously driving for results.
•    Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, including roadmap creation, cost management, and revenue/profitability targets.
•    Financial acumen with the ability to create business cases to support innovative ideas for new product enhancements.
•    Strong communication and leadership abilities are essential for fostering collaboration among cross-functional teams and leading them towards common goals.
•    Strong attention to detail in all areas of the position.
•    Able to effectively operate as a matrix manager in coordinating people and resources from multiple areas of the company to easily handle timelines and project deliverables.
•    Troubleshooting and creative problem-solving skills.
•    Adaptable to navigate changing market trends, new technologies and organizational needs.
•    Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•    Ability to handle several initiatives and priorities simultaneously.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Medical
jobs.description:
​Who We Are

At CPC (Colder Products Company), we’re not just connecting fluid lines – we’re connecting people, ideas, and possibilities. For nearly 50 years, we’ve been engineering cutting-edge fluid connection technologies that power industries from biopharmaceutical, thermal management (liquid cooling of electronics), medical, industrial, and chemical handling markets.

But what sets us apart? Our people.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators, and forward-thinkers who thrive in a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement. Headquartered in Minneapolis/St. Paul, with over 700 employees in 14 countries, we’re growing fast, and we want you to grow with us!

Your Role

Are you ready to make an impact and work with a company that values your expertise, ideas, and career growth? You’ll be at the forefront of shaping our organization’s success. This isn’t just a job – it’s a career move where you’ll thrive, learn, and enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities:

- Develop and manage the market and product roadmaps for identified Medical market opportunities.

- Be the recognized subject matter expert for assigned Medical markets, effectively influencing all levels of company leadership both internally and externally.

- Responsible for growth, profitability, and lifecycle management of assigned product lines.

- Determine customers' and market needs utilizing market research and voice of customer.

- Bring new products to market by defining and analyzing product requirements and product development programs; developing business plans including return-on-investment analysis, critical timeline expectations, and demand forecast.

- Define product marketing communication objectives and collaborate with marketing, sales, and compliance in creation of marketing collateral and sales enablement tools for new and existing products.

- Develop product sales strategies for new and existing product.

- Provide information for management by preparing short-term and long-term product sales forecasts.

- Set product lead times to facilitate growth and optimize the business, while collaborating with operations and supply chain on inventory strategy to maintain appropriate service levels.

- Cross functional collaboration on product quality, cost, and availability to support objectives.

- Obtain and assess product market share in collaboration with commercial partners, developing competitive strategy through detailed knowledge of competitors' products.

- Develop, train others, and deliver customer and market messaging as needed.

- Determine product pricing for new and existing products via value-based pricing strategies with consideration for market and competitive intelligence.

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies.

- Promote and train the CPC organization globally on market, value proposition, and key messages.

- Develop relationships with key decision makers and strategic accounts.

- Mentor and coach team members.

- Comply with all Quality policies while continuously identifying opportunities for improvement.

- Support the process of ISO, ASI, and other certifications deemed necessary by the business.

- Adhere to all safety regulations.

- Other duties as assigned to support business and department needs.

Essential Supervisory Responsibilities:
- Dependent on future business growth, may manage a team of other product managers, product owners, and/or project managers as assigned.

Qualifications:

Basic Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree

- Minimum 7+ years of product marketing experience

- Minimum 5+ years of experience defining and launching new products to market

Preferred Qualifications:
- Engineering or similar technical degree

- MBA from an accredited institution

- 5+ years of experience marketing component products to medical OEMs

- 5+ years of engineering or product management experience for a medical OEM

- Proven experience developing and implementing effective product development plans and strategies in a B2B setting

- Comfortable with ambiguity

- Creative problem solver with global perspective

- Strong written and oral communication skills

- Experience with fluid handling products/markets

- Experience working with and understanding distribution channel dynamics

Travel:

- Up to 15%; Domestic and international.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Our Culture

At CPC, our people aren’t just employees, they’re the driving force behind our success. We’ve built a culture rooted in respect, collaboration, and integrity, where every voice matters, and innovation thrives. It’s not just us saying it; CPC has been recognized as a Top Workplace 6 x in the past 7 years, because we genuinely care about our employees’ growth, well-being, and success. This isn’t just a workplace; it’s a community where you’ll feel valued, empowered, and inspired to do your best work every day.

Growth & Development

We invest in you . Whether you’re looking to expand your skills, take on new challenges, or advance your career, we’re here to support you. We offer:

- Mentorship, hands-on training, and career development opportunities to help you reach your full potential.

- Tuition Assistance to support continued education, plus scholarship programs for children of eligible employees.

- A Co-Op and intern program in partnership with several universities for hands-on industry experience.

- Recognition programs that celebrate your contributions, from employee loyalty awards to peer-to-peer recognition.

Because when you succeed, we all succeed.

Work/Life Balance

We get it – work is important, but so is life outside of it. That’s why CPC ensures you have the time and flexibility to live, recharge, and give back. Our programs include:

- Multiple paid-time off programs, including vacation , sick time, company-paid holidays, bereavement leave, and paid volunteer time to support causes you care about.

- Paid Parental Leave so you can focus on what matters most.

- Wellness support, including access to in-person and online advisors for mental, financial, and overall well-being.

We believe that a balanced, fulfilled team creates the best workplace.

Benefits & Compensation

At CPC, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including but not limited to:

- Health & Wellness:

- Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision coverage starting day one for you and your family.

- Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions for eligible plans.

- Company-paid Long-Term & Short-Term Disability and Life Insurance for added security.

- Onsite gym & wellness programs to help stay active and healthy.

- Financial Benefits:

- 401k plan with automatic employer contributions starting on day one, plus profit-sharing to invest in your future.

- Referral bonuses – get rewarded for connecting talented friends and family to CPC job openings.

- Pay Range : $130,000.00   –   $152,000.00 /  year

- This range is the pay scale for this role in Minnesota. Individual compensation is based on skills, experience, and qualifications related to this position.

- Bonus Eligibility: Yes

Join Us

If you’re ready to be part of an innovative team that values connection and collaboration, we want to hear from you!

Pay Range: USD 130,000.00 - 152000.00 Annually
